rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something not real and can also describe someone or something as insincere.

example.english: This designer bag is fake, so don't buy it.
example.traditional: 呢個名牌袋係假㗎，唔好買。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ming4 paai4 doi6 hai6 gaa2 gaa3 m4 hou2 maai5

rows.note: Use this for behavior, words, or emotions that are obviously insincere or hypocritical rather than counterfeit.

example.english: You don't have to act fake here; I know you don't care.
example.traditional: 你唔使喺度假惺惺，我知你唔關心。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hai2 dou6 gaa2 sing1 sing1 ngo5 zi1 nei5 m4 gwaan1 sam1
